name: AZ-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: District leans Democratic by 4 points on the PVI
Incumbent Greg Stanton is running with a large cash advantage
Stanton has raised $2.1M versus $0.6M for Jasser, with no outside opposition
Prediction markets price Stanton near 97% to win
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Stanton: a D+4 seat, incumbency, an 8-point favorable environment, and a roughly 4-to-1 fundraising edge with no outside spending against him. Markets price this as near-certain, so the forecast stays at a solid Safe D margin near 18 points.
model.watch: A late surge of outside spending against Stanton or a strong national Republican wave environment could narrow the margin.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Greg Stanton seeks a fourth term in a Phoenix-area district that leans Democratic by about four points. He enters the general election with a decisive financial edge, holding roughly $2.0 million on hand after raising $2.1 million, while Republican Zuhdi Jasser has raised about $0.6 million and has minimal cash. No outside groups are spending against Stanton, and no independent or third-party polling of the race is available.

With no expert raters covering the contest, the outlook rests on fundamentals and market pricing, both of which favor Stanton heavily. Prediction markets put his win probability near 97 percent, consistent with a comfortable double-digit expected margin in a favorable environment for incumbents.
